english.title: Bring an animal / animal product into England other than at a designated border inspection post

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: trade in animals and related products regulations 2011

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) brought

(A)_[an animal, namely **(..SPECIFY ANIMAL..),]_
(B)_[a product specified in Commission Decision 2007/275/EC, namely **(..SPECIFY PRODUCT..),]_

into England other than at a border inspection post designated for that

(C)_[animal]_
(D)_[product]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 13, 39 and 42(2) of the Trade in Animals and Related Products Regulations 2011.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
brought an animal / product specified in Commission Decision 2007/275/EC into England other than at a border inspection post designated for that animal / product.

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This offence became a summary only offence from 14th December 2019. For an offence committed on or after 10th February 2025, see offence wording document H102329.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: A fine.

Time Limit for Prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
